exercism.dashboard.description: Shown when the user is on their Exercism dashboard

exercism.tracks.description: Shown when browsing the list of all programming language tracks

exercism.chooseLanguage.description: Second line while browsing the list of tracks (each track is a programming language)

exercism.track.description: Shown when viewing the main page of a programming language track

exercism.trackOf.description: Name of a track. {0} is a programming language, e.g. 'Rust track'

exercism.exercises.description: Shown when browsing the exercises of a track

exercism.viewExercise.description: Shown when viewing an exercise. {0} is the exercise name, e.g. 'Hello World'

exercism.viewAnExercise.description: Shown when viewing an exercise, without naming it (privacy mode)

exercism.solving.description: Shown when solving an exercise in the online editor. {0} is the exercise name

exercism.solvingAnExercise.description: Shown when solving an exercise, without naming it (privacy mode)

exercism.iterations.description: Shown when reviewing the submitted versions (iterations) of a solution. {0} is the exercise name

exercism.iterationsPrivate.description: Shown when reviewing the submitted versions (iterations) of a solution, without naming the exercise

exercism.solutions.description: Shown when reading other people's solutions to an exercise. {0} is the exercise name

exercism.solutionsPrivate.description: Shown when reading other people's solutions, without naming the exercise

exercism.digDeeper.description: Shown when reading approaches and articles about an exercise. {0} is the exercise name

exercism.digDeeperPrivate.description: Shown when reading approaches and articles about an exercise, without naming it

exercism.mentored.description: Shown when a student is in a mentoring session about an exercise. {0} is the exercise name

exercism.mentoredPrivate.description: Shown when a student is in a mentoring session, without naming the exercise

exercism.concepts.description: Shown when browsing the programming concepts of a track

exercism.learning.description: Shown when reading about a programming concept. {0} is the concept, e.g. 'Strings'

exercism.learningAConcept.description: Shown when reading about a programming concept, without naming it

exercism.mentoring.description: Shown when the user is volunteering as a mentor

exercism.mentoringInbox.description: Second line while mentoring: the mentor is checking their inbox

exercism.mentoringQueue.description: Second line while mentoring: the mentor is browsing pending requests

exercism.mentoringStudent.description: Second line while mentoring: the mentor is in a discussion with a student

exercism.mentoringRequest.description: Second line while mentoring: the mentor is reviewing a mentoring request

exercism.journey.description: Shown when the user is viewing their own progress (the 'Journey' page)

exercism.community.description: Shown when viewing the community page

exercism.docs.description: Shown when reading the Exercism documentation

exercism.contributing.description: Shown when viewing the pages about contributing to Exercism

exercism.maintaining.description: Shown when a maintainer is managing tracks

exercism.challenge.description: Shown when viewing a coding challenge, e.g. #48in24

exercism.insiders.description: Shown when viewing the page of Insiders (Exercism's supporter program)

exercism.donate.description: Shown when viewing the donation page

exercism.about.description: Shown when reading the 'About Exercism' pages

exercism.buttonViewExercise.description: Button label that opens the exercise page

exercism.buttonViewTrack.description: Button label that opens the track page (a programming language)
